outside_window.finding: The deadline for the Nasdaq plan to regain compliance under Rule 5250(c)(1), covering the delinquent FY2026 10-K and the Q1 FY27 10-Q, is 2026-10-23. Nasdaq may grant an exception to 2027-02-09, or the company can appeal to a Hearings Panel if the plan is rejected. Any outcome is disclosed after the exit window.

The minimum-bid-price compliance period runs to 2027-02-01, with any reverse split due 10 business days before. The stock is back near $1.06 after closing below $1 in the summer, so compliance or a reverse-split decision lands well after the window.

Restating FY2022-FY2025 and auditing FY2026 both still need a successor auditor, and none was named in the 2026-08-18 8-K or in any later filing. The 10-K is therefore months away, and the restatement size is still unquantified against about $13.9M of revenue the SEC alleges was improperly recognised.
